name: Jonas Ferdinand Gabriel Lippmann
summary: Luxembourgish-French physicist and Nobel laureate known for the Lippmann process of color photography and the capillary electrometer.

name: Hollerich
summary: Location in the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg where Lippmann was born.

name: Grand Duchy of Luxembourg
summary: Country of Lippmann's birth.

name: Paris
summary: City where Lippmann's family moved and where he received his education and worked.

name: Lycée Napoléon
summary: Secondary school in Paris where Lippmann received his early education.

name: École normale
summary: Higher education institution in Paris where Lippmann entered in 1868.

name: Sorbonne University
summary: University in Paris where Lippmann defended his thesis and later became professor.

name: Heidelberg
summary: German city where Lippmann worked with Kühne and Kirchhoff.

name: Berlin
summary: German city where Lippmann worked with Helmholtz.

name: French Academy of Sciences
summary: Scientific academy of which Lippmann became a member in 1886 and president in 1912.

name: Société francaise de photographie
summary: Photography society of which Lippmann was a member and president.

name: Institut d'optique théorique et appliquée
summary: Institute in France of which Lippmann was one of the founders.

name: Lippmann electrometer
summary: Instrument developed by Lippmann based on electrocapillarity.

name: Lippmann process
summary: Method for producing colored photographs without dyes using interference.

name: Nobel Prize in Physics 1908
summary: Award received by Lippmann for his work on color reproduction.

name: Victor Cherbuliez
summary: Novelist and author, father of Lippmann's wife.

name: Miss Cherbuliez
summary: Lippmann's wife and research associate in the study of colors.

name: Marie Skłodowska
summary: Polish student and collaborator of Lippmann.

name: Pierre Curie
summary: Collaborator of Lippmann.

name: Kirchhoff
summary: German researcher and doctoral advisor to Lippmann.

name: Helmholtz
summary: German researcher and academic advisor to Lippmann.

name: Public Research Centre Gabriel Lippmann
aliases: Centre for Public Research e University Center
summary: Research center in Luxembourg named after Lippmann.

name: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology
summary: Institute formed by the merger of Public Research Centre Gabriel Lippmann and Public Research Centre Henri Tudor.
